review_type: Author source-vs-actual-mesh review; independent review remains required

criteria.detail: One coherent object contains front tower, diagonal wing, upper cross-wing, full lower rear classroom body, long windows and external stairs.
Rear wide classroom grid, long high bands and higher narrow A end retained; projecting planted L facade absent. Hidden west closure is neutral, not a measured joint.
Upper main front has three bands of physical vertical fins. Lower diagonal front and entrance-facing side have physical horizontal fins, including a partial full-height screen and open arcade.
Large front portal is not filled. Rear classroom wall and two short internal bridges remain visible within it. Actual STL clear segment tests recorded separately; not a circulation certification.
Rear has two continuous upper window/rail bands, lower broad classroom groups, a separate narrower glazed stack and dogleg stair gap; no copied front-fin facade.
Neutral capped roof and unobserved sides. No invented roof equipment, machine rooms, full sky bridge or L-facade textures.
Concrete, aluminum/steel, dark frames/glass, pale cyan tower and light rear curtains are editable face materials; no source textures.

iterations: Adjusted diagonal low-wing placement after comparing street and elevated front photographs.
Restored entrance-facing horizontal fins seen in interior photo 02-06 instead of a blank inside wall.
Kept the full rear classroom block, long windows, narrow high end and open stair as A while excluding foreground L.
Added a discreet model-only first-stair foot to prevent an unsupported layer start; finite-precision section endpoint welding corrected numerical rounding artifacts without hiding open sections.
important_differences: Exact facade bay/fin counts, stair tread count and geometry are conventional.
Front/back depths and diagonal triangle footprint are coherent approximations, not measured dimensions.
The unoccluded model can show the front tower from rear views where foreground L blocks it in the 2015 photograph.
Upper tower rear, unknown side walls and complete roofs are neutral closures, not confirmed blank architecture.
Original inscriptions/logos, board seams, tie holes, full spiral stair, landscaping and interiors are omitted.
Pale rear window fields abstract glazing/curtains; they are opaque display surfaces, not transparent windows.
claim: Suitable for a bounded public-photo whole-A exterior approximation, not survey/structural/2026-as-built accuracy.
